verdict.rationale: Datadog's Bits AI is documented as an AI assistant for natural-language interaction with telemetry, and the Datadog MCP Server exposes telemetry to AI agents/queries, supporting the core capability. However, evidence is limited to title-level doc links with no detail on whether responses include actual runnable queries or rendered charts, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of quality or accuracy. Missing for 10: detailed docs/examples of Bits AI returning concrete DQL/chart outputs, and independent user validation of natural-language query accuracy.
